subject: Preferred inference footprint and SOC2/BAA checklist — next steps
messages:
From: Grace O’Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@synapsemd.com>, Mark Roberts <mark.roberts@synapsemd.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call notes: preferred inference footprint and compliance ask

Hi Emily / Mark,

Thanks again for the call today 9-- really helpful to understand SynapseMD's production constraints. I wanted to capture the key points and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track items.

Call highlights:
- Workload: peak inference ~45 qps (bursty), average latency target <120ms for user-facing features.
- Data: incoming requests will include PHI (patient identifiers, notes) and SynapseMD requires a signed BAA and SOC2 Type II evidence.
- Residency: primary data residency requirement is US (no cross-border for PHI).
- Risk tolerance: low for any external shared tenancy for PHI; you described a preferences order: Private VPC/on-prem > Dedicated capacity (isolated pools) > Hosted API (only if we can meet BAA + strict contractual controls).

Attachments: redwood_baa_overview.pdf, SOC2_summary.xlsx (attached).

Suggested mutual action plan (MAP) / next steps:
1) You: confirm whether SynapseMD's legal team requires specific BAA language or a redlined doc (Emily).
2) Us (Redwood): provide SOC2 Type II audit report (redacted) and network/PKI topology diagram for Private deployments.
3) Tech deep-dive: schedule a 30-min session with our Private deployment engineer to discuss VPC peering, routing, and on-prem packaging (we can do this next Tue/Wed).
4) Procurement: we will send a ballpark for Dedicated reserved capacity and a Private deployment estimate (engineering effort + monthly platform fee).
5) Evidence sprint: target 5 business days to surface SOC2 artifacts and an initial BAA draft for review.

Please reply to confirm the MAP and add anything I missed. If the ordering above looks right, I will initiate item (2) and loop our security lead.

Thanks,
Grace

Grace O’Connor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O’Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call notes: preferred inference footprint and compliance ask

Emily 9-- thanks for the fast reply and for sending the requirements doc. Couple of responses inline and a concrete MAP with owners/timeline.

Short answers:
- Hosted API: we do not retain request-level PHI in plaintext by default for hosted customers; we use configurable retention windows and can enable tokenization hooks. However, Hosted API is only recommended if you are comfortable with a BAA + contractual controls and the lower isolation model.
- Dedicated: single-tenant GPU pools + tenant isolation at the runtime layer; logs are kept per-tenant and we can restrict backups and snapshot replication to designated regions.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): we provide an installation playbook, Terraform modules for on-prem packaging, and a reference network diagram. For tightly regulated PHI flows this is our strongest guarantee.

Proposed MAP (owners / target dates):
- Redwood: Deliver redacted SOC2 Type II report + network/PKI diagram ("evidence packet") by Wed 2027-09-15 (owner: me + Security).
- SynapseMD: Share legal BAA preferences / sample redlines by Mon 2027-09-13 (owner: Emily).
- Redwood: Provide Dedicated pricing ballpark and Private engineering scoping estimate by Fri 2027-09-17 (owner: Marissa).
- Joint: Technical deep-dive with Private engineer (30m) week of 2027-09-20 (owner: Redwood infra lead).

Ballpark (very rough) to set expectations:
- Dedicated reserved capacity: ~$6k-9k/month depending on GPU class and commit.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): one-time engineering on-boarding estimate $30k-$65k + monthly platform fee ~$4k-$7k (depends on scale and support SLAs).

If that timeline looks feasible I'll start the evidence sprint and cc our security lead. Also linking our internal drive with the BAA template and SOC2 redaction guidelines: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-doc-id-Redwood-SynapseMD

Thanks,
Grace

Grace O’Connor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
